artworks.title: S'administrant la discipline ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure with architectural backgrounds labeled "SEBASTOPOL" and "BOMARSUND." The drawing depicts a figure shown kneeling and bound by loops of rope. The attire suggests a military uniform, with a helmet featuring a prominent plume. In the background, there are faint outlines of structures or fortifications labeled as "SEBASTOPOL" and "BOMARSUND." The style of this drawing, with loose and fluid shading, focuses on conveying emotion and satire. Text below the image reads "S’ADMINISTRANT LA DISCIPLINE" and "C’est par ma faute, par ma faute, par ma très grande faute !".

artworks.title: Renouvelé de la tour barbe bleue
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white illustration of two figures on a stone turret. One figure is looking out over the sea while the other uses a telescope. In the background, there are sailing ships with smoke billowing above them, and cannon fire is shown. The waves and splashes of the shots are depicted dynamically. The style of the drawing suggests a sense of political satire or historic commentary.

artworks.title: Jeunes gens de cinquante a soixante ans ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in animated poses. The scene depicts a dynamic interaction between the two figures, each dressed in early 19th-century attire, including top hats and coats, and holding walking canes. The figure on the left has a larger frame, an expansive coat, and appears to be in a conversational position with an outstretched arm. The figure on the right appears thinner and is caught in a motion that suggests dancing or an animated gesture, with one leg raised and a cane held horizontally. The background is simple, allowing the emphasis to be on the postures and line work of the figures. This drawing is in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Parisiens incrédules ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing on a balcony. The person on the left is using a telescope, and the person on the right is looking outwards. The background shows a night sky with stars and a cityscape below the balcony.

artworks.title: La veille du 13 Juin
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, an older couple, from head to toe, positioned side by side and leaning forward slightly while standing at the edge of a balcony or window. They are looking upward into the sky, which is filled with stars. Both have distinct, bald or receding hairlines, and one has slightly larger ears than the other. The individual on the left is wearing a long-sleeved garment and loose pants, complemented by sandals. The person on the right is dressed in a long gown that reaches their calves, and also wears sandals. The scene is set in a dimly lit room with the only illumination coming from the night sky, casting long shadows around them. There is a visible wrought iron railing at the edge where they are standing, and faint outlines of furniture or drapery can be noted in the background.

artworks.title: In convénient de tirer les perdreaux ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three people and a dog in an outdoor setting. Two individuals in the foreground include a man and a woman. The man, standing with his elbows bent, is wearing a top hat, a coat, and trousers. The woman stands beside him, holding an umbrella and wearing a gown with bonnet-like headwear. An additional figure, likely a young man, is standing barefoot with a rifle in hand in the background. A dog is present nearby. Feathers are scattered throughout the scene, and the sky is filled with birds.

artworks.title: Tiens ... ma femme avec un monsieur ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In the image, two men are sitting closely together in a railway compartment. The man on the left is dressed in a coat and tall top hat, with a mustache and sideburns. The other man is leaning towards the window, looking outside with a furrowed brow. Both men wear 19th-century attire. Through the window, a couple is visible sitting on a bench outside. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like texture with light and shadow details.

artworks.title: Souvenir du grand festival des orphéonistes
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a large group of people standing closely together. Most of them are looking directly at the viewer and appear to be singing, with open mouths and expressive faces. They have a variety of hairstyles and are wearing formal or plain clothing with visible collars. Many are holding sheets, possibly sheet music. The background is filled with more individuals, creating the impression of a large choir. The setting is neutral or indoors, with no specific details beyond the group of people.

artworks.title: Dernière élévation de soulouque
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large anthropomorphic potato or root vegetable with human-like features. The drawing depicts a surreal scene where a gigantic root vegetable, resembling a creature with arms and a face, is towering over the landscape. The figure is rooted into the ground with its leafy top spread out like arms. Around this figure, smaller objects or figures can be seen in motion. The surrounding environment consists of more foliage and clouds, drawn in a stylized manner that emphasizes movement and drama. The use of lines and shading adds texture and depth, creating an almost whimsical yet unsettling atmosphere in this artwork.

artworks.title: Ah! Théophile ... j'en apprends de belles ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image features two people shown from the waist up, situated closely together. On the left, a woman is seated, her upper body turned slightly to the side. She has a distinctive profile with a prominent nose, her hair is neatly styled and pulled back, and she wears a garment with a high collar. The fabric of her clothing is textured. She holds a book open on her lap. Opposite her, a man leans forward, facing the woman with wide eyes and a surprised mouth. The man's hair is short and untidy. He is dressed in loose, wrinkled clothing, with one hand extended outward. The background is lightly shaded, emphasizing the interaction between the two figures in a nondescript indoor setting.

artworks.title: Paysagistes au travail (Landscape Artists at Work)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene depicting two individuals lying on the ground. The foreground features two figures reclining in a relaxed manner on a grassy area. To the right, there are easels with canvases. Additionally, large umbrellas are positioned near the easels. In the background, a landscape unfolds with trees on the left and hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Paris grippé
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures standing close together. They are wearing heavy clothes and appear to be in a cold environment. The central figure is sneezing into a handkerchief while the others look on. The background shows buildings, hinting at a street scene during winter. The style of the drawing includes detailed lines and shading, typical of lithographic printing.

artworks.title: Toujours les merveilles du diamant ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene with five men and one woman captured in a moment of animation. The woman is seated on a chair on the right side of the image with her arms raised above her head and her mouth open. She has long, curly hair and wears a flowing dress with a high collar. One of the men is positioned closely in front of her and appears to be speaking to her. Behind him are four other men standing and observing the scene. The background is plain.

artworks.title: L'incomparable somnabule
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of caricatured figures in a fanciful scene. The scene depicts a seated figure surrounded by a crowd of onlookers. The drawing is done in a style that emphasizes caricature with exaggerated facial features and head sizes. The figures are dressed in period attire, with top hats and elaborate coats. The composition is busy, with the figures tightly packed, creating a sense of liveliness and interaction among them. The expressions on the figures' faces range from curious to amused. The setting appears to capture a moment of spectacle or performance, indicated by the focused attention of the standing figures on the seated figure.

artworks.title: La harpe, instrument céleste
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This illustration features two main figures in exaggerated poses, showing most of their bodies. The figure on the left stands with arms crossed, wearing a ragged sleeveless shirt and shorts, with disheveled hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat. He is positioned with a slight lean and rough textures suggest unkempt, curly hair. The figure on the right is playing a harp, wearing a long-sleeved top with prominent features, including a pronounced nose and a furrowed brow. They appear to have hair styled back and tied with a cloth or type of hat. Between them, a harp is held and played. In the background, there are several seated figures, one of whom is smoking a cigar and writing. Trees and distant figures wearing top hats create a busy outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Les merveilles de la gymnastique ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a billiard table with two caricatured figures. The figures are engaging in humorous interactions around the table. One figure leans back on the table with crossed legs, while the other is focused on making a shot, holding a billiard cue. Both characters have exaggerated facial expressions. The background is plain, directing attention to the figures and the table.

artworks.title: Pisque ca vous amuse ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are standing outdoors. The man on the left has a wide smile, crossed arms, and a cap. The man on the right holds a rake and has a serious expression. They are in a rural setting with leafless trees in the background. The ground looks rough or plowed. French text at the top reads "LES PARISIENS A LA CAMPAGNE," and there is French text below the image.

artworks.title: Le quatrième acte d'un drame intéressant
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated side by side, captured from the waist up. The person on the left is an older man with distinctive facial features and short, dark hair. He is dressed in a dark jacket over a light shirt. The individual next to him appears to be a woman, also seated, with her head down and holding a handkerchief near her face. She wears a bonnet over her hair and a long, dark dress. The background features a textured, indistinct scene with faded, ghostly images of faces.

artworks.title: La dêroute!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image depicts an urn with multiple faces and several figures in a chaotic scene. The central urn is labeled "URNE DU SCRUTIN DU 10 MARS." Surrounding the urn, there are figures in dynamic poses that suggest commotion and disorder. One figure appears distressed, another is interacting with a third figure who is lying down. Various papers with French writings like "INSTRUCTION PUBLIQUE" and "TRAVAUX PUBLIQUES" are scattered on the ground. The scene is crowded with details that convey satire and criticism, possibly of a political nature. The artwork is in the style of Honoré Daumier, known for caricatures and social commentary.

artworks.title: Le rêve d'un marguillier
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a figure in bed, surrounded by large pillows or quilts. Above the figure, there is a scene with another figure wielding a spear over a supine figure on a cloud-like formation. In the background, there are soldiers. Beside the bed, there is a framed drawing of a person with a halo. Light and shadow are used effectively in the image.

artworks.title: Un parricide
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image depicts an interaction between two figures. One figure is a robust man holding a club labeled 'Droit du travail', appearing threatening towards a seated woman representing the press. The man is dynamic and aggressive, leaning forward with an angry expression. He holds a large cudgel with inscriptions related to press freedoms or rights. The woman, identified as 'La Presse', is passive, hunched over while writing. The contrasting poses of the figures create a sense of conflict over press freedom or censorship. The background includes lines adding movement and tension. The figures are monochrome with shadows, enhancing the drama. The caption below reads "Un parricide," suggesting an allegorical attack on a concept or entity.

artworks.title: Un des ... inconvéniens du macadamisage ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in formal attire encountering a dust storm on a street. The drawing shows two individuals in the foreground, both wearing top hats and formal coats, in a conversational stance. They appear engaged in discussion while gesturing towards something off-frame. Behind them, a street scene unfolds with a swirling cloud of dust or smoke obscuring much of the background. In the midst of the dust, other figures can be vaguely discerned, some seemingly holding onto their hats or crouching to brace against the dust. The background depicts the hint of trees and possibly architectural structures, suggesting an outdoor urban setting. The style is caricatural, emphasizing the expressive features and exaggerated postures of the figures. The drawing contains text in French at the bottom.

artworks.title: Suites du macadamisage
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a city street scene with many "For Rent" signs. The scene shows a busy cityscape in the background with buildings displaying "A Louer" or "For Rent" signs. In the foreground, there are exaggerated cartoonish figures expressing distress or frustration. One figure is pulling at its hair while another looks upwards. These figures have caricature-style features. Additionally, a sign on a lamppost or structure indicates "Boutique A Louer." The drawing humorously illustrates a situation of economic downturn, perhaps related to infrastructure changes in a city. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier, known for satirical and social commentary artwork.

artworks.title: Projet de statutes pour orner ... la Bourse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with large statues and columns. The image depicts a structure with massive columns and two statues on plinths at the entrance. One statue on the left portrays a figure wearing a helmet and holding a shield. The other statue on the right depicts a military figure from the 19th century, possibly a general. In the foreground, there are wide steps leading up to the building, and several smaller silhouetted figures are shown. The scene is bustling with movement, suggesting an atmosphere of activity. The drawing uses contrasts of light and shading to emphasize the structural details and the textures of the statues.
